name: 樱町蒸汽机车

parameters.prompt: A complete body-only vintage Japanese miniature steam locomotive, facing +X as in reference. Long horizontal dark sage boiler, rounded smokebox front with brass headlamp, short smokestack, brass dome, cream-windowed enclosed rear cab, thin red buffer beam and small rear coal bunker. Charming richly detailed handmade low-poly toy train, matte sage, charcoal green, cream and restrained brass. Width 1.85 length 5.1 height 2.7. IMPORTANT: body only, ABSOLUTELY NO wheels, axles, bogies, connecting rods, rails, ground, smoke or people; all wheel hardware is added separately by runtime. Keep bottom flat, complete exterior on all sides, no text or baked shadows.

adoption: accepted after front, rear and side visual review; scene integration remains separate

inspection.notes: Locomotive source faces +Z; rotate Y by pi/2 to face +X. Both train bodies contain no wheels.
